npcRig.instance_rule: Parse GLB independently per actor, or verified skeleton-aware clone. Never plain Object3D.clone for independent SkinnedMesh. One Mixer and one bone tree per actor; no scaling skeleton after binding.
npcRig.cm_a01_template: Import source/npc-rig.py and call make_shared_rig(), or use editable PlayerRig/rest bones in blend. Keep exact names/hierarchy/rest/inverse-bind; bind new geometry weights to these bones. Replace mesh, not proportion/scale. Verify new actual GLB fingerprint, full-body poses and soles before adoption. Differing proportions need retarget/rebake; not silently compatible. make_shared_rig requires a new blank scene. The .blend preview PlayerRig object is translated and has PREVIEW Action active: do not export that preview transform/action. Reset object transform to identity, clear preview action, restore exact rest matrices, then attach18 production Actions and verify exported bind/sole before consuming. The Python template constructs the neutral rig directly.

npcRig.body_collision: Use selected variant full-body skinned bounds and real swept collision, not .28m capsule alone.
npcRig.support: Soles measured from selected shoe skinned vertices; animation markers alone cannot prove support. Actual engine stable support .25s required where applicable.

input_contract.immutable_request_fields_ref: FP-PERFORMANCE-R01 schemas.input_request; no extra fields inserted into strict wire schema
input_contract.send: Explicit user send captures current draft and actual scene; clear affirmative current body intent is execution intent. Transaction consent remains explicit; no per-step confirmation for ordinary declared body plan.
input_contract.editing_during_judgment: Changes draft_revision only. Original submitted text displayed separately with modified-draft indicator; no inferred resubmit/cancel.
input_contract.clarification: One necessary question linked to original request, one explicit answer → new request_revision. Full prior meaning/target context stays in server/adapter-owned context; strict parent raw_text stays current immutable text. If host lacks context mapping, report unsupported clarification rather than appending unknown wire fields.
input_contract.replacement: Show explicit replacement/new-submit only once prior execution is safe and invalidated/settled. Never silently stop or replace merely on typing.
input_contract.conditional: Evaluate clause-local conditions against actual state; execute dependent affirmative action only if intent explicitly authorizes it and adopted conditions are verified. Unmet/unknown condition blocks that dependent action; unrelated allowed clauses remain eligible.
input_contract.ime: Enter during composition never submits; Ctrl+Enter/button submit only when can_send and not composing; movement hotkeys suppressed for all text focus.

projection_source_policy.origin: Build from host provenance, never from model text or guessed service state
projection_source_policy.status: Actual job/executor events plus confirmed state; pending plan only proposed; UI chooses capability buttons from supported host operations
projection_source_policy.units: intent_units decision + authentic per-step event aggregation; summarize observed results only, no private NPC knowledge exposure
projection_source_policy.no_wire_override: Client-only draft/focus/projection fields travel in separate adapter-owned state, not FP additionalProperties:false objects

contract_deltas.issue: Parent says editing creates request_revision while JUDGING permits editing with send=false; an unsent edit must not mutate the already dispatched immutable request.
contract_deltas.resolution: Separate client-only draft_revision from dispatched request_revision. Typing changes only draft_revision. Explicit submit/clarifying answer creates request_revision; explicit cancel invalidates a request revision. A staged replacement cannot execute until explicit confirmation and lease release.

contract_deltas.issue: Late plans and late factual executor events have different authority.
contract_deltas.resolution: Cancelled/stale plans never start new steps. Authentic delayed committed executor events are reconciled and deduplicated as historical facts, without marking cancelled intent completed or starting successors.

contract_deltas.issue: Body owner alone does not determine keyboard focus.
contract_deltas.resolution: While judging, manual movement requires scene focus. Typing, IME, text selection and dialog focus suppress movement keys. Closing the composer returns focus but is not implicit request cancellation.

contract_deltas.issue: 30-second UI threshold does not prove the backend job vanished or execution stopped.
contract_deltas.resolution: Show actual host state when available; use UNKNOWN only when state cannot be verified. Same-identity query is available only if host supports it; never pretend query succeeds or spend a new inference call behind it.

contract_deltas.issue: Camera deadline and actor safe-settlement deadline must not be conflated.
contract_deltas.resolution: 350ms blend and1.5s camera fallback follow parent as candidate values. Root control is restored only after actual safe settlement; if still airborne/unsafe, show recovery state and retain root lease even when camera is free.

contract_deltas.issue: An aggregate failure or denial can hide independently completed clauses or unsupported enforcement.
contract_deltas.resolution: Display per-unit semantic decision and actual execution, plus aggregate summary; body facts, application receipt and NPC perception are separate. Blocked intent and visible prevention performance have separate statuses.

invariants.rule: Apply UI results only to the bound runtime candidate/session/request_revision/plan/execution and adopted source identity; no latest-file silent swap.
Draft editing changes client draft_revision only; immutable dispatch snapshot remains. A draft edit is neither execution consent nor automatic cancellation.
can_manual_move requires actual root ownership, scene focus, no IME/text/dialog ownership, actual safe support and active visible session.
No send while JUDGING/PLAN_CHECK/EXECUTING/SETTLING/UNKNOWN; clarification response is explicit and creates new revision. EXPLORE/COMPOSE send also requires host/capacity and no execution lease.
No step starts from cancelled/older request revision. An authoritative historical event may still be reconciled; it must not enable an invalidated plan successor.
Progress/completion use actual executor phases and verified committed events, never model expected_events, subtitle completion, clip elapsed time alone or spinner duration.

WORLD_DENIED references adopted policy/real physics/actor context. ENGINE_UNSUPPORTED is distinct. Physical prevention needs real enabled actors/paired resources and actual observed execution; text refusal never proves prevention.
Keep confirmed past facts; show per-unit result and dependent steps not started. Do not undo movement, consume application consent or share player private plans with NPCs through feedback.
Cancel before dispatch makes0 calls; after dispatch may cost a call; stop future scheduling, settle actual airborne actor, show cancelled intent separate from settled body.
Queries reuse identity, never make a new inference or automatically replay. If unsupported, show unresolved state and recovery limitation rather than a fake query button/result.

Root lease release requires safe settlement and actual release receipt; camera return never writes root. Clear held keys/touches/capture before fresh input; subtitle end cannot hold body control forever.
Live badge requires actual model invocation provenance; author/Mock fixtures are labelled. Counts use host ledger evidence; unavailable remaining count is unknown, never estimated.
Application receipt/knowledge/material/companion/body remain separate. This UI contract neither enables new animation assets nor changes narrative truth/permissions.

transitions.guard: Valid draft+actual host capacity+unique current request identity+no root execution lease
transitions.body: Manual control possible only with scene focus; text focus remains editor-owned

transitions.guard: Editor focus and no IME send
transitions.effect: Increment draft_revision, preserve current submitted revision and actual execution
Preserve original and actual target context; no body scheduling
New request_revision with context linkage; old plan revisions disabled, no automatic repeated clarification call
Local schema/identity/scene/capability/policy check; no body fact
Acquire actual actor resource lease; show actual actor/action/target/phase; no expected success
Invalidate dispatch revision and stop any future start; upstream cancellation may be unsupported and invocation may cost

transitions.guard: Actual safe grounded vs airborne/support status
transitions.effect: Stop successors, retain committed past facts; settle if necessary
Record discard, no execution or success event
Verify event identity/proof/cursor and deduplicate historical facts; never resurrect cancelled plan
Retain last confirmed state, supported same-identity query only; physical safe-recovery ownership continues
Clear controls, invalidate unsupported planned starts, continue actual safe settlement; explicit reconcile/resume only

transitions.guard: Actual safe actor and settled root lease; late plan disabled; requested focus known
transitions.effect: Camera collision-safe return; clear held keys/capture; preserve draft and facts; fresh input required

waiting.initial: 显示已发送/等待反馈；只有host确认判断任务运行才显示结合现场判断中
waiting.thresholds: Inherit parent candidate values; elapsed time alone never proves model or execution state

presentation.plan: Show short understood intent/targets and current phase; detailed IDs/graph/cost/trace are development evidence, not mandatory player-facing controls
presentation.result: Show what happened, what did not, why, and available next operation. Hide unavailable capabilities or show explicit unavailable state; no false enabled query/cancel capability.
presentation.world_denial: Explain source-supported reason; show prevention happening/completed only if actual enforcement started/completed. Otherwise show physical prevention unavailable separately.
presentation.control_return: Parent350ms blend/1.5s camera fallback remain candidate values; actor settlement independent and never forced by UI timeout
presentation.voice: Entry retained but unavailable in this package; no microphone permission/recording/transmission
presentation.mobile: Touch focus/cancel visibility and browser keyboard need separate device verification; desktop contract does not imply mobile acceptance

ui.evidence_ceiling: Source-bound document candidate and author static/semantic review only; no actual model/dynamic performance/speech/browser/independent QA/human acceptance
